title: Signal-weighted customer lifecycle prioritization for roadmap intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and ship a calibrated, signal-weighted prioritization engine that ranks incoming customer requests and escalations across the customer lifecycle (onboarding, growth, renewal risk) and surfaces a single priority score into the roadmap intake queue. The goal is to reduce manual triage time, align product decisions to account health and revenue risk, and provide transparent rationale for commit decisions.
background: Current intake is heavily manual: CSMs and AMs email PMs or raise tickets with inconsistent context. Existing top-account frameworks are qualitative and require repeated PM judgment. We lack a repeatable numeric signal that combines engagement, spend, escalations, and product telemetry into a single prioritized list for planning cycles.
proposal: Define a compact set of customer lifecycle signals, normalize them into a 0-100 range per-account, apply time-decay windows, and compute a weighted sum to produce a PriorityScore. Integrate PriorityScore into the intake form and roadmap queue, expose breakdown in Console (per-account signals), and add a manual adjustment field for PM/SE override with audit logging.
scoring_factors: Active usage (DAU/MAU ratio, API token call volume) — 14-day window
Renewal horizon & contract cliff — binary boost within 120 days
Customer advocacy signals (NPS, reference interest) — 180-day window
Platform error rate or regression alerts attributed to product — 30-day window
weighting_proposal: Initial weights: Revenue 30, Active usage 20, Escalations 25, Incidents 10, Renewal Horizon 10, Advocacy 5. We will run sensitivity analysis and provide an adjustable slider UI in Console so product/CS leadership can re-balance for a planning cycle.
acceptance_criteria: PriorityScore is computed nightly for all accounts and visible in the intake queue
Console shows per-account signal breakdown and time window annotations
Manual override field exists with audit trail and reason required
Score explains 85% of accepted roadmap escalations in a 6-week retrospective (baseline to be measured)
CS and Sales can submit feedback via a one-click contest action on items flagged as high priority
rollout_plan: Week 1: Build prototype scoring pipeline (batch job) and a demo dashboard for PM/CS review
Week 2: Run backfill for last 12 months, validate weight sensitivity, and iterate with top 5 accounts
Week 3: Integrate score into intake form (alpha) and enable manual override for PMs
Week 4: Pilot with two customer success pods and collect acceptance metrics
Week 6: GA to all intake flows with training docs and embedded Console help
success_metrics: Reduction in manual triage time for PMs by 40% (measured by time-to-decision)
Alignment: >=75% of items accepted into roadmap originate from top quartile of PriorityScore
Accuracy: PriorityScore precision of accepted escalations >= 0.75 in pilot period
CS satisfaction (post-pilot survey) >= 4.0/5 on perceived fairness of prioritization
open_questions: Should we include a qualitative override taxonomy (e.g., strategic partner vs urgent bug)?
Do we expose raw signal inputs to sales/CS or only the normalized breakdown?
How to weight small but high-strategic accounts vs large but low-engagement accounts?
Engineering cost to build real-time vs nightly scoring pipeline (tradeoffs to quantify)
decisions: Initial decision: implement nightly batch score first to limit infra work; expose breakdown to internal teams only during pilot. Manual override will be limited to PMs and above; CS will have a contest button that annotates and escalates but not directly change score.
